rationale: JWKs URL is keyed by user_id (/<user_id>/.well-known/jwks.json), so an attacker who signs up controls the public key endpoint the verifier consults for tokens claiming their user_id. They generate an RSA keypair, publish the public half via the per-user JWKs endpoint, and sign a token claiming admin to fetch /admin/flag. Classic JWT-trust auth_bypass via attacker-controlled key material.
scanner_alignment: Logic specialist covers auth_bypass per SPECIALIST_VULN_MAP.
